description: This PHP script manages the setup and dependencies of picklist fields within the vtiger CRM system, including permission checks, AJAX handlers for fetching and saving dependencies, and rendering appropriate templates.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Smarty template engine wrapper used for rendering HTML templates.

methods.name: getDependentPickListModules
methods.description: Retrieves list of modules with dependent picklist fields.

methods.name: checkCyclicDependency
methods.description: Checks if creating a dependency between two picklist fields would cause a cyclic dependency.

methods.name: getAvailablePicklists
methods.description: Fetches available picklist fields for a module.

methods.name: getDependentPicklistFields
methods.description: Gets all dependent picklist fields for a module.

methods.name: getPickListDependency
methods.description: Retrieves the dependency mapping between source and target picklist fields.

methods.name: savePickListDependencies
methods.description: Saves the dependency configuration for picklist fields.
